decisions.reason: The page says only "confused", with no "acute". Clouded consciousness (synonym "confused", VHA's ACVPU form) and Acute confusion (VHA's "Confusion" warning-sign anchor) are both readings of that word, so the danger sign fires whichever form records it.
"Unable to walk unaided" includes patients who can walk only with help, which Unable to walk alone misses (A's own note says so); Dependent for walking covers "unaided".
Needed as checked-for evidence for the signs-of-meningitis priority rule kept below ("severe headache with neck stiffness/vomiting").
